verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own built-in web UI and agent platform let users chat with models inside the product. Its `local-ai chat` agent reads your files and answers questions about them, and agents can attach MCP servers for live data, so users can get AI output grounded in their data. There is no documented dedicated insights or suggestions feature, so this works through general-purpose chat and agents. missing for 10: a purpose-built feature that surfaces insights and suggestions from user data, documentation of data analysis or insight workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
